trade_journal_examples.lessons: Earnings beat + raised guidance. Held for 30 days for PEAD drift. Trailed stop to breakeven at +1R, exited at +2.5R.
Bought breakout above 20-day high but volume was below average. Market was ranging (ADX 18). Breakout failed, stopped out. Should have checked regime first.
Banking sector was ranked #1 by momentum. Bought HDFCBANK on pullback to 20DMA. Rode the trend for 45 days, trailed stop to +2R before exit.
Held through earnings (mistake). INFY missed estimates and lowered guidance. Stock gapped down 8%. Should have exited before earnings or hedged.
PSU banks were in a structural uptrend. Bought SBIN on breakout above 500. Volume confirmed (2x average). Trailed stop, exited on first close below 20DMA.
Tried to buy at support in a range. Support broke (false breakdown). Stop hit. Range trading requires waiting for confirmation, not anticipating.
TATAMOTORS was undervalued (P/E 8) AND showing momentum (above 200DMA, making higher highs). Value + momentum combo is powerful. Held for 60 days.
Bought WIPRO as IT sector laggard hoping for catch-up. But laggards stay laggards in bull markets. Should have bought the leader (TCS) instead.
Auto sector momentum turned positive (ranked #2). Bought MARUTI on breakout. Volume confirmed. Exited when sector momentum started fading.
Bought on valuation (P/E 18, cheap for pharma). But FDA warning letter hit next week. Regulatory risk is real in pharma. Can't predict black swans.

statistics.key_lesson: Regime detection first. Strategy second. Never hold through earnings.
